name: Keeping A Good Name
overview: Scripture emphasizes the supreme value of maintaining a good name, highlighting that mercy, truth, and integrity should be deeply ingrained in the believer's heart as a foundation for favor with God and man (Proverbs 3:3-4). A good name surpasses material wealth and is linked to righteousness, mercy, and honor, which bring life and blessing not only to the individual but also to their descendants (Proverbs 21:21; 22:1; 20:7). The contrast between the just and the wicked is stark: the memory of the righteous is blessed, while the name of the wicked decays (Proverbs 10:7), underscoring the eternal significance of living a life marked by uprightness.
